name: Perception
summary: Raw electrical signals become meaningful — edges become objects, vibrations become words, pressure becomes texture.
description: The primary sensory cortices perform initial processing: V1 (occipital lobe) detects edges and motion, A1 (temporal lobe) separates frequencies, S1 (parietal lobe) maps touch. The 'what' pathway (ventral stream, toward temporal lobe) identifies objects. The 'where' pathway (dorsal stream, toward parietal lobe) locates objects in space. Perception is not passive — the brain uses predictive processing, constantly generating expectations about what it will perceive next.
